seo.title: Privacy policy | Avesta Tech
seo.description: How Avesta Tech collects, uses and protects personal data under the GDPR (AVG): what we collect, why, how long we keep it, and your rights.

sections.heading: Privacy policy
sections.sub: How we handle personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, in Dutch: AVG).

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The controller is Avesta Tech, KvK [KVK_NUMBER], [BUSINESS_ADDRESS], Utrecht, the Netherlands. Email: [EMAIL].

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: Contact form: your name, work email, company (optional), the service you are interested in and your message.
CRA readiness checker: your answers stay in your browser. We receive them only if you choose "Email me this result"; then we receive your email address and your answers.
Booking a call: the details you enter in our booking tool ([BOOKING_URL]).
Analytics: by default this website uses no analytics and sets no tracking cookies. Analytics tool, if any: [ANALYTICS_TOOL].

sections.heading: Why we use it and our legal basis
paragraphs: To answer your question and prepare a quote: steps at your request before a contract, and our legitimate interest in replying to business enquiries (Article 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).
To deliver a service you ordered: performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
To keep our administration: legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiries that do not lead to work, and client data and findings: [RETENTION_PERIOD], unless you ask us to delete them earlier. Invoices and administration: as long as Dutch tax law requires.

sections.heading: Processors
paragraphs: We use these processors, each under a data processing agreement: [PROCESSORS_LIST].

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: We prefer processors in the European Economic Area. If data is transferred outside it, we rely on an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses, and we list it under Processors.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access to, correction of, deletion of, or a copy of your personal data (portability), and you can object to processing. Email [EMAIL]. We answer within one month.

sections.heading: Complaints
paragraphs: If you are not satisfied with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy: [EMAIL]. Security issues: [SECURITY_EMAIL].
